newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Novosibirskenergo 96 ord dividend 600 rbls vs 500.
newsitem.headline: Novosibirskenergo 96 ord dividend 600 rbls vs 500.

text.p: Shareholders in Russian regional energy company Novosibirskenergo approved a 600 rouble dividend per ordinary share on 1996 results and a 1,400 rouble dividend on preferred shares, the company said on Monday.
It said it paid 500 roubles per ordinary share on 1995 results and a 3,000 rouble dividend on preferred shares.
Both ordinary and preferred shares have a face value of 1,000 roubles.

The shareholders voted to increase authorised but unissued preferred shares by 3.29 million shares, which will take preferred stock to 25 percent of capital from 16.9 percent, AO Novosibirskenergo spokesman Vadim Matveyev told Reuters. The total number of shares is about 16 million.

Matveyev said voting on an eightfold increase in authorised charter capital to 128.6 billion roubles from 16.075 billion roubles was dropped from the agenda for administrative reasons, but would be voted on at an extraodinary shareholders meeting in September or October.

Matveyev said Novosibirsk's biggest shareholders are currently the Novosibirsk administration with 30 percent of shares, national power company UES EESR.RTS with 12 percent and Russia's IFK Alemar with 30 percent.
